oracle-l5r-10352.note: Read the Essence (Spell, Torn Asunder, issue #674): "Open: Bow this card and target one face-down card in a province, or one or two such cards if this Shugenja is Void: Turn the targets face-up." Everything else exists (a bow-this-card cost; Second City's Political Open turns a face-down card face-up), but the engine names a face-down province card only by its province (the any-province command parameter, TargetPlayerId + Province, because a face-down card's id is hidden from the view), and that is ONE card. A Void Shugenja's "one or two" needs a second province in the same command (and a pair listing in QueryActions); no multi-province selection exists, and a card id may not be used (hidden information). Question for Mendon: may the Void version be two separate entries (one province each) sharing one use, or is a two-province selection UI wanted?
